title.en: IELTS Reading: Skimming and scanning against the clock
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Vaqt tigʻiz paytda tez koʻz yugurtirish va qidirib oʻqish
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Просмотровое и поисковое чтение на время

body.en:
When the clock is running, you cannot read a passage twice. Read it once, with a plan.
1. Make a map. Read the first sentence of each paragraph and give the paragraph a label of two or three words. This takes about 2-3 minutes a passage.
2. Read the question and decide the shape of its answer: a year or a date (digits), a name or a place (a capital letter), an amount (a number and a unit).
3. Use your map to choose the paragraph. Then run your eyes down it and look only for that shape.
4. When you find one, stop and read the whole sentence. Does it answer this question?
If a question takes you more than a minute, mark it, move on, and come back if time is left.
body.uz:
Vaqt ketib borayotganda matnni ikki marta oʻqishga ulgurmaysiz. Uni bir marta, lekin reja bilan oʻqing.
1. Xarita tuzing. Har bir xatboshining birinchi gapini oʻqing va xatboshiga ikki-uch soʻzli nom bering. Bunga har bir matnda taxminan 2-3 daqiqa ketadi.
2. Savolni oʻqing va javob qanday koʻrinishda boʻlishini aniqlang: yil yoki sana (raqamlar), ism yoki joy (bosh harf), miqdor (son va oʻlchov birligi).
3. Xarita boʻyicha kerakli xatboshini tanlang. Keyin unga tez koʻz yugurtirib, faqat shu koʻrinishdagi javobni qidiring.
4. Topgach, toʻxtang va butun gapni oʻqing. U aynan shu savolga javob beradimi?
Bitta savolga bir daqiqadan koʻp vaqt ketsa, uni belgilab qoʻying, keyingisiga oʻting va vaqt qolsa, qaytib keling.
body.ru:
Когда время ограничено, прочитать текст дважды не получится. Читайте один раз, но с планом.
1. Составьте карту. Прочитайте первое предложение каждого абзаца и дайте абзацу название из двух-трёх слов. На это уходит около 2–3 минут на текст.
2. Прочитайте вопрос и решите, как выглядит ответ: год или дата (цифры), имя или место (заглавная буква), количество (число и единица измерения).
3. По карте выберите абзац. Затем быстро пробегите его глазами и ищите только ответ такого вида.
4. Нашли — остановитесь и прочитайте всё предложение. Отвечает ли оно именно на этот вопрос?
Если на вопрос уходит больше минуты, отметьте его, идите дальше и вернитесь к нему, если останется время.

body.en:
Text:
Brakton Mill was built beside the river to grind flour for the farms around it. It stopped working in 1961, and for many years the building stood empty.
In 2018 the Halden Trust paid for a new roof and a new water wheel. Volunteers did most of the inside work themselves.
Today the mill is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m., and a guided tour starts at 2 p.m.
Question: Who paid for the repairs?
1. Map: 1 what the mill was; 2 the repairs; 3 opening times.
2. Shape: a name, so look for capital letters.
3. Paragraph 2: "the Halden Trust paid for a new roof". Answer: the Halden Trust.
Now you. Question: At what time does the mill open on Sundays?
1. Shape: a time, so look for digits with a.m. or p.m.
2. Map: opening times are in paragraph 3.
3. Scan it: it has four times. Read the words next to each one.
4. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Matn:
Brakton Mill was built beside the river to grind flour for the farms around it. It stopped working in 1961, and for many years the building stood empty.
In 2018 the Halden Trust paid for a new roof and a new water wheel. Volunteers did most of the inside work themselves.
Today the mill is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m., and a guided tour starts at 2 p.m.
Savol: Who paid for the repairs?
1. Xarita: 1 tegirmon tarixi; 2 taʼmirlash; 3 ish vaqti.
2. Javob koʻrinishi: nom, demak bosh harflarni qidiring.
3. 2-xatboshi: «the Halden Trust paid for a new roof». Javob: the Halden Trust.
Endi siz. Savol: At what time does the mill open on Sundays?
1. Javob koʻrinishi: vaqt, demak a.m. yoki p.m. bilan yozilgan raqamlarni qidiring.
2. Xarita: ish vaqti 3-xatboshida.
3. Unga koʻz yugurtiring: unda toʻrtta vaqt bor. Har birining yonidagi soʻzlarni oʻqing.
4. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Текст:
Brakton Mill was built beside the river to grind flour for the farms around it. It stopped working in 1961, and for many years the building stood empty.
In 2018 the Halden Trust paid for a new roof and a new water wheel. Volunteers did most of the inside work themselves.
Today the mill is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m., and a guided tour starts at 2 p.m.
Вопрос: Who paid for the repairs?
1. Карта: 1 чем была мельница; 2 ремонт; 3 часы работы.
2. Вид ответа: название, значит, ищите заглавные буквы.
3. Абзац 2: «the Halden Trust paid for a new roof». Ответ: the Halden Trust.
Теперь попробуйте сами. Вопрос: At what time does the mill open on Sundays?
1. Вид ответа: время, значит, ищите цифры с a.m. или p.m.
2. Карта: часы работы — в абзаце 3.
3. Пробегите его глазами: время там указано четыре раза. Прочитайте слова рядом с каждым.
4. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: the first match is not always the answer.
When you scan fast, it is easy to grab the first number or name of the right shape. But a text often has two of the same kind: two years, two prices, two names.
Question: When did the library move to its new building?
Text: "The library opened in 1952 in two rooms above the post office. In 1989 it moved to a new building on Mill Road."
1952 is the first year you meet, but it is when the library opened. The words next to 1989 say "moved to a new building". Answer: 1989. ✔
So when you find a match, read the words around it and check that they fit the question.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: birinchi topilgan moslik har doim ham javob emas.
Tez qidirganda kerakli koʻrinishdagi birinchi son yoki nomni ilib olish oson. Lekin matnda koʻpincha bir turdagi ikkita narsa boʻladi: ikki yil, ikki narx, ikki ism.
Savol: When did the library move to its new building?
Matn: «The library opened in 1952 in two rooms above the post office. In 1989 it moved to a new building on Mill Road.»
1952 — siz birinchi uchratgan yil, lekin bu kutubxona ochilgan yil. 1989 yonidagi soʻzlar: «moved to a new building». Javob: 1989. ✔
Demak, moslik topgach, uning atrofidagi soʻzlarni oʻqing va ular savolga mos kelishini tekshiring.
body.ru:
Осторожно: первое совпадение — не всегда ответ.
Когда ищете быстро, легко схватить первое число или имя нужного вида. Но в тексте часто есть два однотипных факта: два года, две цены, два имени.
Вопрос: When did the library move to its new building?
Текст: «The library opened in 1952 in two rooms above the post office. In 1989 it moved to a new building on Mill Road.»
1952 — первый год, который вы видите, но это год открытия библиотеки. Рядом с 1989 стоят слова «moved to a new building». Ответ: 1989. ✔
Итак, найдя совпадение, прочитайте слова вокруг него и проверьте, подходят ли они к вопросу.

title.en: IELTS Reading: Multiple choice and short answers
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Bir nechta variantli savollar va qisqa javoblar
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Выбор ответа и краткие ответы

body.en:
In multiple choice, you read a question or an unfinished sentence and choose the one answer that agrees with the text.
1. Read the question first, not the options, and mark its key words.
2. Find the part of the text it is about: scan for the key words or for words that mean the same.
3. Read that part closely and say the answer to yourself in your own words.
4. Then check each option against the text. The right one says the same idea in other words. A wrong one often uses words from the text but changes the meaning, or is true but does not answer the question.
Short answers are found the same way, but you write the answer yourself: words from the text, within the word limit, for example NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS.
body.uz:
Multiple choice (bir nechta variantli savol) topshirigʻida siz savol yoki tugallanmagan gapni oʻqiysiz va matnga mos keladigan yagona javobni tanlaysiz.
1. Avval variantlarni emas, savolni oʻqing va undagi kalit soʻzlarni belgilang.
2. Matnning savolga tegishli qismini toping: kalit soʻzlarni yoki ular bilan maʼnodosh soʻzlarni qidiring.
3. Shu qismni diqqat bilan oʻqing va javobni ichingizda oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan ayting.
4. Keyin har bir variantni matn bilan solishtiring. Toʻgʻri variant oʻsha fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi. Notoʻgʻri variant koʻpincha matndagi soʻzlarni ishlatadi, lekin maʼnoni oʻzgartiradi yoki toʻgʻri boʻlsa ham savolga javob bermaydi.
Qisqa javoblar (short answers) ham shunday topiladi, faqat javobni oʻzingiz yozasiz: matndagi soʻzlar bilan, belgilangan soʻz soni doirasida, masalan NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS.
body.ru:
В задании Multiple choice (выбор ответа) вы читаете вопрос или незаконченное предложение и выбираете единственный ответ, который соответствует тексту.
1. Сначала прочитайте вопрос, а не варианты, и отметьте в нём ключевые слова.
2. Найдите место в тексте, о котором идёт речь: ищите ключевые слова или слова с тем же значением.
3. Внимательно прочитайте это место и мысленно сформулируйте ответ своими словами.
4. Затем сравните с текстом каждый вариант. Верный передаёт ту же мысль другими словами. Неверный часто повторяет слова текста, но меняет смысл, или верен, но не отвечает на вопрос.
Краткие ответы (short answers) ищут так же, только ответ вы пишете сами: словами из текста, в пределах лимита, например NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS.

body.en:
Text: "Every September, members of the Ridgeway Bird Club count the swallows that gather above Holt Farm before they fly south. The birds rest in long rows on the telephone wires, so the counters work in pairs: one watches through binoculars and the other writes the numbers down. They always start at sunrise, while the birds are still. Last year the total was 640 birds, and the results were sent to a national bird charity."
Question: What does one member of each pair look through? (NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS)
1. Question words: "what ... look through": a thing.
2. Find the place: "one watches through binoculars". "look through" = "watches through".
3. Copy the word from the text, within the limit. Answer: binoculars.
Now you. Question: At what time of day does the counting begin?
1. Question words: "what time of day": a part of the day, not a month or a year.
2. Find the place: look for a word that means "begin".
3. Copy the words from the text, within the limit.
4. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Matn: «Every September, members of the Ridgeway Bird Club count the swallows that gather above Holt Farm before they fly south. The birds rest in long rows on the telephone wires, so the counters work in pairs: one watches through binoculars and the other writes the numbers down. They always start at sunrise, while the birds are still. Last year the total was 640 birds, and the results were sent to a national bird charity.»
Savol: What does one member of each pair look through? (NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS)
1. Savol soʻzlari: «what ... look through» — biror narsa.
2. Joyini toping: «one watches through binoculars». «look through» = «watches through».
3. Soʻzni matndan, belgilangan soʻz soni doirasida koʻchiring. Javob: binoculars.
Endi siz. Savol: At what time of day does the counting begin?
1. Savol soʻzlari: «what time of day» — kunning bir qismi, oy yoki yil emas.
2. Joyini toping: «begin» bilan maʼnodosh soʻzni qidiring.
3. Soʻzlarni matndan, belgilangan soʻz soni doirasida koʻchiring.
4. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Текст: «Every September, members of the Ridgeway Bird Club count the swallows that gather above Holt Farm before they fly south. The birds rest in long rows on the telephone wires, so the counters work in pairs: one watches through binoculars and the other writes the numbers down. They always start at sunrise, while the birds are still. Last year the total was 640 birds, and the results were sent to a national bird charity.»
Вопрос: What does one member of each pair look through? (NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS)
1. Слова вопроса: «what ... look through» — предмет.
2. Найдите место: «one watches through binoculars». «look through» = «watches through».
3. Перепишите слово из текста в пределах лимита. Ответ: binoculars.
Теперь попробуйте сами. Вопрос: At what time of day does the counting begin?
1. Слова вопроса: «what time of day» — время суток, а не месяц и не год.
2. Найдите место: ищите слово со значением «begin».
3. Перепишите слова из текста в пределах лимита.
4. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: an option that repeats the words of the text is often a trap.
Text: "Most of the old trees in Fairley Park were planted by schoolchildren in the 1950s, not by the first gardeners of the park."
Question: Who planted most of the old trees?
A  The first gardeners of the park. The words are from the text, but the text says "not by" them.
B  Children who were at school at the time. Other words, the same meaning. ✔
So match the meaning, not the words. Small words can change everything: not, only, all, some, before, after.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: matndagi soʻzlarni takrorlaydigan variant koʻpincha tuzoq boʻladi.
Matn: «Most of the old trees in Fairley Park were planted by schoolchildren in the 1950s, not by the first gardeners of the park.»
Savol: Who planted most of the old trees?
A  The first gardeners of the park. Soʻzlar matndan olingan, lekin matnda «not by» deyilgan.
B  Children who were at school at the time. Soʻzlar boshqa, maʼno bir xil. ✔
Demak, soʻzlarni emas, maʼnoni solishtiring. Kichik soʻzlar maʼnoni butunlay oʻzgartirishi mumkin: not, only, all, some, before, after.
body.ru:
Осторожно: вариант, который повторяет слова текста, часто оказывается ловушкой.
Текст: «Most of the old trees in Fairley Park were planted by schoolchildren in the 1950s, not by the first gardeners of the park.»
Вопрос: Who planted most of the old trees?
A  The first gardeners of the park. Слова взяты из текста, но в тексте сказано «not by».
B  Children who were at school at the time. Другие слова, тот же смысл. ✔
Итак, сравнивайте смысл, а не слова. Маленькие слова могут изменить всё: not, only, all, some, before, after.

title.en: IELTS Reading: Paraphrase: the same idea in other words
title.uz: IELTS Reading: Parafraz — bir fikr, boshqa soʻzlar bilan
title.ru: IELTS Reading: Перефразирование — та же мысль другими словами

body.en:
IELTS questions rarely copy the words of the text. They say the same idea in other words: a paraphrase. Five common ways:
1. Another word: "bought" → "purchased", "rise" → "go up".
2. Another form of the word: "decided" → "made a decision".
3. The sentence turned round: "The council built the school" → "The school was built by the council".
4. A negative: "rarely" → "not often", "kept" → "did not throw away".
5. A general word for specific ones: "cars and buses" → "vehicles".
A true paraphrase keeps every part of the meaning: who, what, how much, when and how sure. Check each part.
body.uz:
IELTS savollari matndagi soʻzlarni kamdan-kam aynan takrorlaydi. Ular oʻsha fikrni boshqa soʻzlar bilan aytadi — bu parafraz (paraphrase). Beshta keng tarqalgan usul:
1. Boshqa soʻz: «bought» → «purchased», «rise» → «go up».
2. Soʻzning boshqa shakli: «decided» → «made a decision».
3. Gapni majhul nisbatda qurish: «The council built the school» → «The school was built by the council».
4. Inkor orqali: «rarely» → «not often», «kept» → «did not throw away».
5. Aniq narsalar oʻrniga umumiy soʻz: «cars and buses» → «vehicles».
Haqiqiy parafraz maʼnoning har bir qismini saqlaydi: kim, nima, qancha, qachon va qanchalik ishonch bilan aytilgan. Har bir qismni tekshiring.
body.ru:
Вопросы IELTS редко повторяют слова текста. Они передают ту же мысль другими словами — это перефразирование (paraphrase). Пять частых способов:
1. Другое слово: «bought» → «purchased», «rise» → «go up».
2. Другая форма слова: «decided» → «made a decision».
3. Предложение в пассиве: «The council built the school» → «The school was built by the council».
4. Через отрицание: «rarely» → «not often», «kept» → «did not throw away».
5. Общее слово вместо конкретных: «cars and buses» → «vehicles».
Настоящее перефразирование сохраняет каждую часть смысла: кто, что, сколько, когда и насколько уверенно. Проверяйте каждую часть.

body.en:
Text: "Ferhat Bakery opened on Station Road ten years ago. At first it sold only bread, but within two years it had added cakes and pastries because customers kept asking for them. Its owner, Ferhat Aksoy, still bakes every loaf himself, starting at four in the morning. Today most of its customers order online and collect their food on the way to work."
Question: Which sentence means the same as the second sentence?
1. Cut it into meaning parts: only bread at first; within two years; added cakes and pastries; because customers asked.
2. Check an option part by part: "It soon began to sell cakes and pastries as well as bread, because people wanted them." Every part is there. ✔
3. "Within two years it stopped selling bread." "stopped" changes the meaning. ✘
Now you. Question: Which sentence means the same as the last sentence of the text?
1. Meaning parts: most customers; order online; collect their food; on the way to work.
2. Check each option part by part. One changed word is enough to make it wrong.
3. Answer: ?
body.uz:
Matn: «Ferhat Bakery opened on Station Road ten years ago. At first it sold only bread, but within two years it had added cakes and pastries because customers kept asking for them. Its owner, Ferhat Aksoy, still bakes every loaf himself, starting at four in the morning. Today most of its customers order online and collect their food on the way to work.»
Savol: Which sentence means the same as the second sentence?
1. Gapni maʼno qismlariga boʻling: avval faqat non; ikki yil ichida; tort va pishiriqlar qoʻshildi; chunki xaridorlar soʻragan.
2. Variantni qismlab tekshiring: «It soon began to sell cakes and pastries as well as bread, because people wanted them.» Hamma qism bor. ✔
3. «Within two years it stopped selling bread.» «stopped» maʼnoni oʻzgartiradi. ✘
Endi siz. Savol: Which sentence means the same as the last sentence of the text?
1. Maʼno qismlari: xaridorlarning koʻpchiligi; onlayn buyurtma; ovqatini olib ketadi; ishga ketayotib.
2. Har bir variantni qismlab tekshiring. Notoʻgʻri boʻlishi uchun bitta oʻzgargan soʻz kifoya.
3. Javob: ?
body.ru:
Текст: «Ferhat Bakery opened on Station Road ten years ago. At first it sold only bread, but within two years it had added cakes and pastries because customers kept asking for them. Its owner, Ferhat Aksoy, still bakes every loaf himself, starting at four in the morning. Today most of its customers order online and collect their food on the way to work.»
Вопрос: Which sentence means the same as the second sentence?
1. Разбейте предложение на смысловые части: сначала только хлеб; за два года; добавились торты и выпечка; потому что покупатели просили.
2. Проверьте вариант по частям: «It soon began to sell cakes and pastries as well as bread, because people wanted them.» Все части на месте. ✔
3. «Within two years it stopped selling bread.» «stopped» меняет смысл. ✘
Теперь попробуйте сами. Вопрос: Which sentence means the same as the last sentence of the text?
1. Смысловые части: большинство покупателей; заказывают онлайн; забирают еду; по дороге на работу.
2. Проверьте каждый вариант по частям. Одного изменённого слова достаточно, чтобы он стал неверным.
3. Ответ: ?

body.en:
Watch out: a near paraphrase may change one small word, and then it says something else.
Text: "Some of the club members may go on the trip."
✘ "Most of the members will go on the trip." (some → most; may → will)
✘ "None of the members can go on the trip." (some → none)
✔ "Part of the club might go on the trip."
Words to check every time: some / most / all / none; may / will / must; before / after; because / although.
Also check the direction: "A caused B" is not "B caused A".
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: deyarli parafraz boʻlgan gap bitta kichik soʻzni oʻzgartirishi mumkin, shunda u boshqa narsani aytadi.
Matn: «Some of the club members may go on the trip.»
✘ «Most of the members will go on the trip.» (some → most; may → will)
✘ «None of the members can go on the trip.» (some → none)
✔ «Part of the club might go on the trip.»
Har safar tekshiriladigan soʻzlar: some / most / all / none; may / will / must; before / after; because / although.
Yoʻnalishni ham tekshiring: «A caused B» — bu «B caused A» degani emas.
body.ru:
Осторожно: почти точный пересказ может изменить одно маленькое слово, и тогда он говорит уже другое.
Текст: «Some of the club members may go on the trip.»
✘ «Most of the members will go on the trip.» (some → most; may → will)
✘ «None of the members can go on the trip.» (some → none)
✔ «Part of the club might go on the trip.»
Слова, которые нужно проверять каждый раз: some / most / all / none; may / will / must; before / after; because / although.
Проверяйте и направление: «A caused B» — это не «B caused A».

stem.en:
The Lake Orlen walking club meets every Sunday at the boathouse. New members can join at the door, and the yearly fee is twelve pounds.

The shortest route goes round the small lake and is 4 kilometres long. The longest one follows the river to the stone bridge and back, a walk of 11 kilometres.

Walkers who want a middle distance often take the forest path, which is 7 kilometres and has two places to rest.

How far is the club's longest walk?

options.en: 11 kilometres
4 kilometres
7 kilometres
12 kilometres

why.en: "11 kilometres": the longest route is "a walk of 11 kilometres". 4 is the shortest route and 7 the forest path; twelve is the fee in pounds.
why.uz: «11 kilometres»: eng uzun yoʻl — «a walk of 11 kilometres». 4 — eng qisqa yoʻl, 7 — oʻrmon yoʻli; 12 esa yillik aʼzolik toʻlovi (funtda).
why.ru: «11 kilometres»: самый длинный маршрут — «a walk of 11 kilometres». 4 — самый короткий, 7 — лесная тропа; двенадцать — взнос в фунтах.

stem.en:
Brakton Mill was built beside the river to grind flour for the farms around it. It stopped working in 1961, and for many years the building stood empty.

In 2018 the Halden Trust paid for a new roof and a new water wheel. Volunteers did most of the inside work themselves.

Today the mill is open from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. on weekdays. On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m., and a guided tour starts at 2 p.m.

At what time does the mill open on Sundays?

options.en: 9 a.m.
2 p.m.
5 p.m.

why.en: "11 a.m.": "On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m." 9 a.m. and 5 p.m. are the weekday times; 2 p.m. is when the guided tour starts.
why.uz: «11 a.m.»: «On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m.». 9 a.m. va 5 p.m. — ish kunlaridagi vaqt; 2 p.m. — ekskursiya boshlanadigan vaqt.
why.ru: «11 a.m.»: «On Sundays it opens later, at 11 a.m.». 9 a.m. и 5 p.m. — время в будни; в 2 p.m. начинается экскурсия.

stem.en:
The Kerrow ferry has carried passengers across the bay since 1934. For most of those years the crossing took forty minutes, but in 2015 the old boat was replaced by a faster one, and the trip now takes twenty-five minutes. The ticket office opens thirty minutes before the first boat, which leaves at 8 a.m. in winter and an hour earlier in summer. At the far side, the boat waits ten minutes before it comes back.

How long is the crossing today?

options.en: twenty-five minutes
forty minutes
thirty minutes
ten minutes

why.en: "twenty-five minutes": since the faster boat came, "the trip now takes twenty-five minutes". Forty minutes was the old time; thirty and ten are other waits.
why.uz: «twenty-five minutes»: tezroq qayiq kelgach, «the trip now takes twenty-five minutes». Qirq daqiqa — eski vaqt; oʻttiz va oʻn daqiqa esa kutish vaqtlari.
why.ru: «twenty-five minutes»: с новым, более быстрым паромом «the trip now takes twenty-five minutes». Сорок минут — прежнее время; тридцать и десять минут — время ожидания.

stem.en:
The village of Tamsin has had a weekly market for more than a century, but a few years ago only four stalls were left, and the council thought about closing it. Instead, a group of young farmers asked to run it themselves. They moved it from Tuesday morning to Friday evening, when people are home from work, and added food stalls and music. The market now has more than thirty stalls.

Why did the farmers move the market to a different day and time?

options.en: So that more people could come after work
Because the council asked them to close it on Tuesdays
So that there would be room for food stalls and music
Because only four stalls opened on Friday evenings

why.en: "Friday evening, when people are home from work": the new time suits people after work. The council never asked this, and the music came with the move, not as its reason.
why.uz: «Friday evening, when people are home from work»: yangi vaqt ishdan qaytgan odamlarga qulay. Kengash buni soʻramagan; musiqa koʻchirish sababi emas.
why.ru: «Friday evening, when people are home from work»: новое время удобно людям после работы. Местный совет об этом не просил; музыка — не причина переноса.

stem.en:
Every September, members of the Ridgeway Bird Club count the swallows that gather above Holt Farm before they fly south. The birds rest in long rows on the telephone wires, so the counters work in pairs: one watches through binoculars and the other writes the numbers down. They always start at sunrise, while the birds are still. Last year the total was 640 birds, and the results were sent to a national bird charity.

Answer the question. Use NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS from the text.

At what time of day does the counting begin?

options.en: sunrise
September
sunset
midday

why.en: "sunrise": "They always start at sunrise", and "start" = "begin". September is the month of the count, not a time of day; sunset and midday are not in the text.
why.uz: «sunrise»: «They always start at sunrise»; «start» = «begin». September — sanash oyi, kun vaqti emas; sunset va midday matnda yoʻq.
why.ru: «sunrise»: «They always start at sunrise»; «start» = «begin». September — месяц подсчёта, а не время суток; sunset и midday в тексте нет.

stem.en:
The library in Brennick was built to hold books, not people, and for most of its history the reading room was half empty. When a new head librarian arrived, she did not buy more books; she took some shelves away. In their place came long tables with power points, and the library began to stay open until ten at night. Students preparing for exams now fill the room every evening, although the number of books borrowed has hardly changed.

What does the writer say about the changes at the library?

options.en: They brought in more people, but not more borrowing.
They added more books to the shelves for students.
They left the reading room half empty in the evenings.
They doubled the number of books that students borrow.

why.en: Students "now fill the room every evening", but the books borrowed have "hardly changed". She bought no books, and "half empty" describes the past.
why.uz: Talabalar «now fill the room every evening», lekin oʻqishga olingan kitoblar soni «hardly changed». Yangi kutubxonachi kitob sotib olmagan; «half empty» — oʻtmish haqida.
why.ru: Студенты «now fill the room every evening», но число выданных книг «hardly changed». Новая заведующая книг не покупала; «half empty» — о прошлом.

stem.en:
The footpath along the Ravel canal is popular with walkers, cyclists and people fishing from the bank. Last year the canal company widened it in several places, because cyclists and walkers kept meeting on the narrow bends. It also put up signs asking cyclists to ring a bell before they pass. The company says it will add benches and a drinking fountain next spring.

Which sentence means the same as the second sentence of the text?

options.en: Last year parts of the path were made broader, as people on foot and on bikes kept coming face to face where it turned.
Last year the company made the whole path wider, because cyclists kept meeting walkers on it.
Last year the company made the path narrower on the bends, so that cyclists would have to slow down when they came to them.
Next spring the company will make the path wider where walkers and cyclists meet.

why.en: "widened it in several places" = "parts of the path were made broader"; "narrow bends" = "where it turned". Not the whole path, not narrower; next spring is for benches.
why.uz: «widened it in several places» = «parts of the path were made broader»; «narrow bends» = «where it turned». Butun yoʻlak emas va torroq ham emas; kelasi bahorda esa oʻrindiqlar qoʻyiladi.
why.ru: «widened it in several places» = «parts of the path were made broader»; «narrow bends» = «where it turned». Расширили не всю тропу, и её не сужали; весной добавят скамейки.

stem.en:
Ferhat Bakery opened on Station Road ten years ago. At first it sold only bread, but within two years it had added cakes and pastries because customers kept asking for them. Its owner, Ferhat Aksoy, still bakes every loaf himself, starting at four in the morning. Today most of its customers order online and collect their food on the way to work.

Which sentence means the same as the last sentence of the text?

options.en: These days the majority of buyers order on the internet and pick up their food as they go to their jobs.
These days all of its buyers order their food on the internet and have it brought straight to their offices.
These days most buyers order in the shop and eat their food there before work.
These days only a few buyers order online, and most come to the shop after work.

why.en: "most" = "the majority", "order online" = "order on the internet", "collect ... on the way to work" = "pick up their food as they go to their jobs". The rest change who, how or when.
why.uz: «most» = «the majority», «order online» = «on the internet», «collect ... on the way to work» = «pick up their food as they go to their jobs». Qolganlari maʼnoni oʻzgartiradi.
why.ru: «most» = «the majority», «order online» = «on the internet», «collect ... on the way to work» = «pick up their food as they go to their jobs». Остальные меняют смысл.

stem.en:
Engineers in the town of Ostra expected the new ring road to reduce traffic in the old centre. In fact, the opposite happened at first: the new road made the town easier to reach, so more people drove in to shop. Only after the council closed the centre to cars at weekends did the streets become quieter. Shop owners, who had feared the closure, now say their weekends are busier than ever.

Which sentence means the same as the second sentence of the text?

options.en: At the start, the new road brought more cars into town, because shoppers now found it simpler to get there.
At the start, the new road cut the traffic in the centre, just as the engineers had expected.
At the start, so many people drove into town to shop that a new road had to be built.
At the start, the new road made the town much harder to reach, so fewer people than before came in to shop.

why.en: "made the town easier to reach, so more people drove in": the road came first and brought more cars. The other sentences reverse the result or the cause.
why.uz: «made the town easier to reach, so more people drove in»: avval yoʻl, keyin koʻproq mashina. Qolganlari natijani yoki sababni teskari qiladi.
why.ru: «made the town easier to reach, so more people drove in»: сначала дорога, потом больше машин. Остальные переворачивают результат или причину.
